title: Create: Bionics
description: A mod that adds robot animals to Create
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f995f7efc79df80a2620b5ab46353ab935f7539_0.webp)

A small Create add-on that adds three craftable robot animals. All three are meant to help with survival exploration and resource gathering, the only expense being the occasional refueling with coal, charcoal, or blaze cakes.
All three robots can be customized with andesite, brass, and copper variants accessible by simply right-clicking on the robots with the respective ingot. Note that you need to remove cosmetic skins with a wrench.

# Anole
![Anole crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc2ecd6e666fe2cce5b77984b948ecb49502624b_0.webp)

The Anole is a small lizard robot that can be crafted early in the game and accompany your adventures in mob or item form, the latter sitting on your shoulder when held in either hand. The presence of the anole, whether in your hand or walking by your side, is enough to scare away all spiders and insects. In addition to the standard andesite, brass, and copper, the Anole also has a netherite skin and oxidized variants that can be applied with a wet sponge. 

# Oxhauler
![Oxhauler crafting recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79f6cf9cbf47f8a934fe247669b01abafb1eaed1_0.webp)

The Oxhauler is a large cow-like robot that carries 6 chests worth of storage, as well as a full 3x3 crafting grid. Additionally, it can easily plough land and harvest crops when given a mechanical plough or a mechanical harvester respectively.

# Replete
![Replete Crafting Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a194fc614ea2789d19241dc60583dc0126f4467a_0.webp)

The Replete's stand-out feature is its massive fluid tank, capable of carrying 160 buckets of any fluid, including those from other mods. The Replete is an easy way to transport fluids across long distances when trains are unavailable and/or the distance is too far to warrant a pipe system. Use a wrench to toggle fluid absorbing, allowing the Replete to gather surrounding fluids if they match the contents of its tank.

**This mod will not be posted to Curseforge due to their history of bad business practices including cutting creator revenue, hosting malware, and promoting knockoff mods and other scams. **
